meta.title: Charles Bouvier – Fullstack developer
meta.description: Portfolio of Charles Bouvier, fullstack developer (React, TypeScript, Java, .NET) based in Île-de-France and Normandy.

hero.intro: I build web applications from the interface to the database. I graduated from a BUT in Computer Science, completed two front-end internships (one in English with an international remote team), and I’m now looking for a permanent role as a fullstack developer.

marketplace.title: C2C marketplace
marketplace.description: A platform where individuals sell items to each other, built on a microservices architecture with Spring Boot and React.

yatai8.title: Yatai 8
yatai8.description: A horror game about spotting anomalies in a looping space, built with Unity and C# and released on Steam.

readabilityRadar.title: Readability Radar
readabilityRadar.description: A tool for Japanese learners that rates the difficulty of subtitles, articles and text files (JLPT levels) and estimates their reading time.

lightsRemnants.title: Light’s Remnants
lightsRemnants.description: A 2D platformer built with Unity and C#, in which the player guides a character through a series of levels.

bullets: Built scripts that export data to PDF and Excel, and import it into databases in the format each client required.
Designed automated solutions to generate multilingual documents.
Maintained these scripts for more than 50 client companies.
Built the interface of an AI assistant for artists with React, Next.js and Tailwind CSS.
Worked every day in English with an international technical team.
Managed and tracked IT equipment, phones, printers and stock.
Ran and developed internal applications and managed server access under security (SSI) rules.
Liaised with e.SNCF and coordinated with ESTI.
Handled goods, inventory and deliveries, and optimized stock flows.
